messages.en:
{07 00 00}Lately, I've become very 
interested in collecting
fossils, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 06 00}The more I find, the more I
want!{01 00 00 05 00} I know that sounds
odd, but I can't help it.
{07 16 00}I hope I find one today!{01 01 00}
If I don't, the whole day
will be a bit of a waste.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Viimasel ajal olen ma 
väga huvitunud fossiilide
kogumisest, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 06 00}Mida rohkem ma leian, seda
rohkem tahan!{01 00 00 05 00} Tean, et see
kõlab veidralt.
{07 16 00}Loodan, et leian täna!{01 01 00}
Kui ei leia, on terve päev
pisut raisku läinud.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}What do you
think of {01 00 00 05 00}fossils?{01 00 00 05 00} Do you
like 'em, {04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Some people think they're
gross.{01 00 00 05 00} ...I guess I
can understand that.
{07 19 00}They are bones, after all.{01 00 00 05 00}
And bones can be kinda
creepy{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 06 00}But me personally, I just
love fossils! They're so
darn interesting!
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, you should
help me improve my fossil
collection, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}Mida sa

{07 00 00}Mõned arvavad, et nad
on jälgid.{01 00 00 05 00} ...Ma vist
saan sellest aru.
{07 19 00}Nad on ju ikkagi luud.{01 00 00 05 00}

pisut jubedad{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 06 00}Aga mina isiklikult lihtsalt

nii pagana huvitavad!
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, sa peaksid
aitama mul oma fossiilikogu
täiendada, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
